# Living Design System — Tokens [![Build Status](https://ci.falcon.walmart.com/buildStatus/icon?job=LivingDesign%2Ftokens)](https://ci.falcon.walmart.com/job/LivingDesign/job/tokens/)

Living Design System's design tokens.

## Getting started

```shell
# With yarn
yarn add -D @livingdesign/tokens

# With npm
npm install -D @livingdesign/tokens
```

## Usage

Tokens are built in several formats.

### Web

#### CSS

```css
@livingdesign/tokens/dist/css/light/globals.css
```

#### JavaScript

```js
import * as globalTokens from "@livingdesign/tokens/dist/js/light/globals.js";
```

#### JSON

```js
const globalTokens = require("@livingdesign/tokens/dist/json/light/globals.json");
```

#### Sass

```scss
@import "~@livingdesign/tokens/dist/scss/light/globals";
```

### React Native

```js
import * as globalTokens from "@livingdesign/tokens/dist/react-native/light/globals.json";
```
